trial_metadata.execution_note: This is a designed/comparative analysis of expected Vanilla Codex behavior based on documented Codex capabilities and the Project Expertise Flow design. Actual execution deferred to user or future phase.

design_phase.observation: Without Factory bootstrap gate, Codex may skip explicit architecture design and start coding immediately when not prompted to design first.
design_phase.risk: May produce code without full entity/API/page planning, leading to rework.

safety.observation: Without Security Gate, .env.production.example may contain example secrets. No automatic detection of deploy traces.
safety.risk: Secrets could accidentally be included if developer is not vigilant.

code_quality.observation: Codex produces functional code. Tests may be written but without CLASSIFICATION_FIRST policy, skipping env-dependent tests is ad-hoc.
code_quality.risk: Test suite may have inconsistent skip/fail behavior.

documentation.observation: README produced on request. No Package QA Gate to enforce manifest or ZIP reconciliation.
documentation.risk: Handoff ZIP may be missing files or have unreconciled manifest.

user_intervention.observation: Without Build Lite structure, user must manually remind Codex about each phase: design, safety checks, testing strategy, documentation.
user_intervention.risk: Higher cognitive burden on user to remember all steps.
